bug_semantics: On Cassandra 4.0.16, a non-superuser granted MODIFY ON ALL KEYSPACES can INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE rows in system_auth (roles, role_members, role_permissions), including flipping is_superuser, because ClientState still treats the DataResource root (ALL KEYSPACES) as a parent of every system table. PROTECTED_AUTH_RESOURCES only rejects CREATE/ALTER/DROP on those tables, not MODIFY. CVE-2025-23015 / CASSANDRA-20090 was supposed to stop ALL KEYSPACES grants from covering system keyspaces and to refuse GRANT of MODIFY/CREATE/DROP/AUTHORIZE/EXECUTE on them; 4.0.16 recorded that ticket in CHANGES.txt after merging cassandra-3.11, but the 4.0 Java blobs were left identical to 4.0.15. 4.0.17 re-applies the real patch: system-keyspace checks walk Resources.chain(resource, IResource::hasParent) so the ALL KEYSPACES root is skipped, and GrantPermissionsStatement rejects Permission.INVALID_FOR_SYSTEM_KEYSPACES on non-virtual system keyspaces.
flaw_origin: The exploitable ClientState hole was first written in CASSANDRA-4898 (0b83682b40d3, 2013-02-15): that commit added CQL3 system_auth tables (PasswordAuthenticator/CassandraAuthorizer) and changed the PROTECTED_AUTH_RESOURCES guard from blocking every permission to blocking only CREATE/ALTER/DROP, so DML proceeded into the existing Resources.chain() walk up to DataResource.root() (ALL KEYSPACES). Parent ee0be0624b0e still threw 'Resource %s is inaccessible' for any permission on protected auth resources and had no CQL authorizer tables. Those 4.0.16 ClientState/Permission/GrantPermissionsStatement/Resources/SchemaConstants blobs equal 4.0.15; merge 0cbc8d99f6e3 (3.11 into 4.0) kept 4.0 'ours' (ClientState f76e7e3a4f80) rather than 3.11's patched 2416b8be1a1b. A merge that failed to take the 3.0/3.11 fix is not a first-write BIC.

reasoning: CVE.org publishes CVE-2025-26467; it is the 4.0.16 leftover of CVE-2025-23015 (CWE-267), not a withdrawn/false advisory. Attack path: authenticate as a role with MODIFY ON ALL KEYSPACES, then DML system_auth.roles (protected against DDL only) to set is_superuser. The 4.0.17 closer is 066c489d76, which inserts the system-keyspace exclusion immediately before ensurePermissionOnResourceChain and blocks GRANT of MODIFY on system keyspaces; that commit is in cassandra-4.0.17 and absent from cassandra-4.0.16. 4.0.16 advertised CASSANDRA-20090 via a 3.11 merge and CHANGES.txt but keep-ours left the 4.0.15 authorization blobs in place, so 4.0.16 is still the pre-fix mechanism. Protocol BIC is the smallest first-write of those vulnerable lines, not the later bad merge or the 3.0 fix commit: git log -L and parent-tree show 0b83682b40d3 (CASSANDRA-4898) first replaced the total protected-resource deny with the DDL-only check while adding CQL-writable auth tables; parent ee0be0624b0e still denied all access and lacked those tables. Blame at 4.0.16 still attributes the throw line to that commit. AI is judged only on that BIC commit object: 2013 human committer with reviewer trailer and no AI authorship markers, so NOT_AI.
